projects.title: HealthBook (AI + Automation — Next.js, FastAPI, pgvector, Supabase)
projects.description: Built an AI medical booking agent that reduced appointment scheduling time by 90% (30 min → <3 min). Orchestrated a Browser Use SDK agent to automate Zocdoc navigation and trigger real AI phone calls to doctor offices via OpenAI Realtime API and Twilio. Eliminated repeated health history entry across sessions by engineering a pgvector semantic memory pipeline in Supabase — retrieving top-3 relevant memory chunks via cosine similarity and injecting them into each agent task prompt.

projects.title: Nutribase (IoT & Full-Stack — MERN, C++, ESP32)
projects.description: Built a MERN-stack Smart Fridge Tracker with secure role-based authentication and user analytics dashboards. Programmed custom ESP32 firmware in C++ to stream real-time weight data (>10 payloads/second) to a scalable Node.js backend via low-latency MQTT/HTTP pipelines. Reduced food waste tracking errors and unauthorized access by 60%.

projects.title: Quizki (Full-Stack — React, Node.js, Google Gemini API, Auth0, MongoDB)
projects.description: Grew platform to 100+ unique sessions by shipping gamified reward loops, progress dashboards, and Auth0/JWT authentication achieving <1s login latency. Cut average study session setup time by 50% by integrating the Google Gemini API to deliver personalized LLM-generated study prompts via Node.js endpoints (<1.5s response time).

projects.title: AutoBook (Automation Engine — Python, Selenium, WebDriver)
projects.description: Achieved >95% reservation success rate on high-demand UCSD library rooms by engineering a Python/Selenium automation engine that fully eliminates a 5-step manual booking workflow. Reduced room acquisition time by >90% (from ~10 min to <2 sec) by simulating WebDriver interactions with precise timing to capture slots within seconds of availability release.

projects.title: ShortStack (Platform Architecture — Flask, Redis, Docker, Prometheus, Nginx)
projects.description: Reduced redirect latency by 93% (30ms → <2ms on cache hits) by integrating Redis caching across 3 load-balanced Nginx replicas, validated under 500 concurrent users via Locust load testing. Achieved 84% test coverage across 25 automated tests with a full CI pipeline (GitHub Actions) orchestrating 7 Docker containers with health checks, auto-restart policies, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
